name: Albertine Sarges (DE) | Musikcaféen
description:
Albertine Sarges' new album, Girl Missing, is the highly anticipated follow-up to her acclaimed 2021 debut, The Sticky Fingers.

The project emerged from personal loss—after a close friend abruptly cut ties, Albertine turned to songwriting, assembling a musical mosaic of love and longing. “I was crafting a sonic biography of love,” she reflects, intertwining themes of female friendship throughout. The missing girl of the title is not just someone lost, but someone longing.

Eclectic yet deeply personal, Girl Missing blends indie rock, blues, art pop, and 1970s influences with Albertine’s agile vocals. Alongside longtime collaborator Lo Selbo, she shaped intricate soundscapes with airy flutes, layered choirs, and vintage organs to create warmth and vulnerability. The album took shape in two contrasting locations: the industrial landscape of Berlin-Marzahn, where Albertine explored the confessional depths of her songs, and the coastal town of Margate, where she refined them at the PRAH Foundation studio.

Balancing whimsy with melancholy, Girl Missing closes with a wry joke—"How do you call a fish with no i’s? A fsh."—yet remains a poignant meditation on loss and renewal. For her upcoming tour in fall 2025, Albertine will gather her full band, celebrating music as a reason to come together.

name: Lucy Yeghiazaryan Quartet – Jazz i verdensklasse
description:
Lucy Yeghiazaryan kombinerer den klassiske, elegante jazzvokal med en særlig intim kommunikation og kontakt med publikummet. Hendes repertoire består af jazzstandards, som altid resonerer med hendes egne livshistorie, samt egne kompositioner, som inviterer lyttere ind i hendes liv. Siden hun flyttede til New York i 2015, har hun udgivet 5 anmelderroste plader, turneret i Nordamerika og Europa med navne som Harold Mabern, Emmet Cohen, Houston Person og Rodney Whitaker, og etableret sig som en af fremtidens store navne indenfor jazzmusik.

Med på scenen er tre af Skandinaviens mest efterspurgt jazzmusikere: Pianist Magnus Hjorth (Marius Neset, Snorre Kirk, DR Big Band, m.fl), kontrabassist Graig Earle (Lars Jansson, Denzal Sinclaire, Niels Lan Doky, m.fl) og trommeslager Cornelia Nilsson (Mathias Landæus, Kenny Barron, Seamus Blake), hvis fælles kendetegn er et stærkt, virtuost, og solidt understøttende sammenspil og dybt swingende time feel.

Det bliver en jazzoplevelse du sent vil glemme, når de fire musikere optræder med jazz i verdensklasse!

Line-up:

Lucy Yeghiazaryan – Vokal
Magnus Hjorth – Flygel
Graig Earle – kontrabas
Cornelia Nilsson – trommer

Praktisk info

Fredag den  15. november 2025
Kl. 20 / Dørene åbner kl. 19.30
Unummererede siddepladser

name: Poetry Unleashed
description:
Poetry Unleashed is an open mic format where 12–16 poets present their own texts to the audience. The evening features two sets of poetry, a short break, and the chance to stay afterwards for a drink and conversation.

The event was established in Copenhagen in August 2023 and has quickly become a gathering point for poets, authors, zine creators, and anyone seeking a creative community around poetry. Each month, Poetry Unleashed brings together voices from across the world, offering the audience a unique glimpse into today’s diverse poetry scene.

The program is divided into two parts: the first set runs from 20:00 to 20:50, followed by a short break, and the second set from 21:05 to 22:00.

name: Triptides (US) + The Sonic Dawn (DK)
description:
From sun-drenched Los Angeles, Triptides bring their kaleidoscopic brand of psychedelic rock, where shimmering guitars, airy vocals, and hallucinogenic fuzz melt into timeless sonic landscapes. On stage, the band is pure transformation – a trip that lifts the audience from the first note and never quite lets them down again.

Copenhagen’s own The Sonic Dawn have, across five albums and hundreds of shows, earned a reputation as one of Europe’s most explosive psych-rock bands. Their blend of soulful vocals, swirling guitar, and pulsing grooves has the power to turn a venue into a euphoric, dancing frenzy.

This double concert unites two bands who channel psychedelic traditions in their own unique ways – together promising an evening of sonic journeys where reality vibrates in tune with the music.

name: Åbningsfilm - Empire Bio - The Toxic Avenger
description:
THE TOXIC AVENGER ER ÅBNINGSFILM PÅ BLODIG WEEKEND😎

Kom med til den legendariske og forrygende åbning af Blodig Weekend!

Der er underholdningsgaranti, når vi sparker festen i gang med den vanvittige genindspilning af den i forvejen vanvittige kultklassiker ”The Toxic Avenger”🎬

Vi byder på øl fra vores samarbejdspartner Dry & Bitter Brewing Company, du vil kunne købe årets T-shirt og andet merch, det vamle og stinkende program venter på dig og så vil der være uhyggelig velkomsttale og gruopvækkende intro til filmen🍺👕

name: ASTA + Royal Hinus
description:
Denne aften kan du opleve ASTA, der med dansksprogede tekster bevæger sig mellem alvor og humor. Musikken er en kompromisløs blanding af støjrock, artpop og jazzet punk, inspireret af blandt andre Sonic Youth, First Flush og PJ Harvey. Med poetiske angreb på verdens forfængelighed synger ASTA om hudsult, havfruer og hår under armene – alt sammen leveret med både rå energi og sårbarhed.

Derefter går Royal Hinus på scenen – en dansk indie supergruppe bestående af Adam Peleg (Pacific Swell), Patrick Rathbun (Pardans, Gäy), Asger Overgaard (Gäy) og Öskar Dinesen (Pardans, Ecstasy in Order). De spiller intens rockmusik med rødderne solidt plantet i jorden og ambitionerne rettet mod skyerne, hvor det musik man troede var familiært bliver vendt, drejet, knust og sammensat igen i et kalejdoskop af ekstatisk musikalitet. Indflydelserne spænder bredt. Fra et udgangspunkt i en eksperimenterende blues-punk bliver der trukket tråde til blandt andet country, jazz, progressiv rock og klassisk musik. Det rå og det ømme, det umiddelbare og det tænkte komplementerer og afveksler hinanden på en måde hvor modsætningerne opløses i en opløftende ny enhed.

name: Fællesmøde - Extinction Rebellion København
description:
(English below)

Hey! Er du klar til at skride til handling imod regeringens og magtens ødelæggende og manglende handlinger i et klima- og naturkollaps? Så kom med i fællesskabet i Extinction Rebellion København.

Fællesmødet er for alle. For dig der er helt ny i XR men også for dig, der har været med længe. For dig, der bare har lyst at spise med, og for dig, der har lyst til at planlægge aktioner eller holde møder om outreach, medie, logistik og meget mere.

Et af målene med fællesmøderne er at skabe et stærkt fællesskab i XR København, hvor vi støtter og motiverer hinanden. Så kom forbi og vær med!

Der vil være både engelsk- og dansk-talende grupper.

Mødet afholdes på Greenpeace-kontoret, Lyngbyvej 100.

/// English ///

Hey! Are you ready to take action against the climate crisis and the collapse of nature? Join the community of Extinction Rebellion Copenhagen.

Fællesmøde (common meeting) is for everyone. For those who are brand new to XR, but also for those who have been a part of the movement for a long time. For those who just want to join for dinner, and for those who want to plan actions or have meetings on outreach, media, logistics and much more.

One of the main goals with fællesmøder is to create a strong community in XR Copenhagen where we support and motivate each other. So join us and take part in the community!

There will be both English and Danish speaking groups, and whisper translation for those who need it.

The meeting takes place at Greenpeace's office, Lyngbyvej 100.

name: Intromøde til Extinction Rebellion København
description:
(English below)
Kom forbi og vær med i klimakampen på en måde, der batter!
Kom til intromøde, inden der er fællesmøde i XR København, og få en kort introduktion til Extinction Rebellions plan for, hvordan vi kan ændre regeringens katastrofale klimakurs.

Der vil være mulighed for information og samtaler på både dansk og engelsk.

Efterfølgende starter fællesmødet i XR, hvor du kan få et indtryk af og deltage i, hvad der sker rundt omkring i de forskellige grupper, og hvilke planer der er for fremtidige events og aktioner.

Mødet afholdes på Greenpeace-kontoret, Lyngbyvej 100.

--- English ---
We need more activists in Extinction Rebellion to be able to work even harder for climate and ecological justice! So come by and figure out if XR is the right movement for you.

Join the intro meeting (before the XR common meeting) and get an introduction to Extinction Rebellion's values, demands, and way of working.

You can get info and have conversations both in English and Danish.

Afterwards, we will hold our common meeting. Here you can get an idea of what’s going on in the different groups and what kinds of events and actions we have planned for the future.

The meeting is held at Greenpeace's office, Lyngbyvej 100.

name: Johanne Mygind: Giftig
description:
Den lokale Sydhavnsforfatter, Johanne Mygind udkommer d. 30. oktober med hendes nye bog, Giftig. En fortælling om Cheminova og det svære i at fortælle sin egen families historie.

Denne aften får vi muligheden for at høre om tilblivelsen af romanen og de problemstillinger og udfordringer, som har draget Johanne Mygind til at fortælle historien om Cheminova, hvor hendes morfar var driftsdirektør og regnes for at være bagmanden bag Danmarkshistoriens største miljøkatastrofe. 

Hvordan fortæller man en familiehistorie, der stadig rummer eksistentielle efterskælv generationer senere? Hvem har magten, privilegiet, ansvaret og evnen til at beskrive dét, som har fundet sted i så giftigt et foretagende?

Kom og vær en del af denne inspirerende begivenhed, hvor vi får mulighed for at opleve Johanne Myginds nye roman og dykke ned under overfladen på en historie, der fortsat har konsekvenser for familier og naturen ved Harboøre.

Der vil også være mulighed for at købe et splinternyt eksemplar af bogen.

Det er gratis at deltage, men man skal hente en billet på https://billetto.dk/e/johanne-mygind-giftig-billetter-1674575

Om Giftig:

Dokumentaristen Nanna rejser til Vestjylland for at skrive en roman om sin families hemmelighed: Hendes morfar var driftsdirektør på Cheminova og ansvarlig for Danmarkshistoriens største miljøkatastrofe. Nannas plan er at skrive en stor roman. Den skal være som Matador, bare med gift, og med sin baggrund er hun selvskreven til at fortælle historien. Som led i sin research bliver Nanna tilknyttet Lemvig Museum og flytter ind i en fugtig lille lejlighed i byen, mens hendes kæreste og børn bliver tilbage i København.

I 1953 ankommer Nannas bedsteforældre, Henning og Rigmor, til Lemvig sammen med deres lille datter. De er fulde af forhåbninger om et bedre liv. Men Henning lader sig opsluge af arbejdet på fabrikken, og inden længe indser Rigmor, at gift kan sive ind overalt, selv i et ægteskab. Og også i nutidens Vestjylland må Nanna erkende, at hun ikke længere har grebet om sin egen historie og arv.

name: Lærere er til for at lære
description:
Step into a dark and absurd comedy that exposes the hidden power struggles of school life, sharply and directly. Here, parent-teacher conferences, rants and trust exercises merge into a puppet theatre-like universe where you never quite know whether you are attending a lesson, a negotiation or a team-building exercise.

Teacher Asger finds himself in the middle of a conflict that starts with the children but quickly escalates to involve the adults. Two mothers are furious about swearing, boundaries and discipline, and Asger must try to control the situation while accusations fly, language breaks down and the phone rings incessantly. Gradually, it becomes unclear who is actually behaving most childishly – the children or the adults?

The performance provides a surreal insight into today's classroom, where political battles over upbringing, inclusion and freedom of expression are fought alongside ambitious learning goals. We examine the purpose of teaching in 2025 and ask whether society's expectations are compatible with parental cooperation, where everything is up for negotiation. Who sets the limits and who is held accountable? And, not least, are we teaching the children anything at all – or are they teaching us adults that we still have a lot to learn?

In Asger's classroom, there must be room for everyone – including you. So come in, join the discussion and experience a community that negotiates itself to death one sentence at a time.

(The play is in danish)

name: Release: Town Portal
description:
For more than a decade, the Copenhagen trio Town Portal has challenged and thrilled audiences with their unique blend of heavy riffs, offbeat rhythms and captivating melodic structures. Now they are ready to celebrate the release of their fourth album, Grindwork (2025), with a release concert where the music will be allowed to unfold in full force.

Grindwork marks a new direction for the band. After the dark and stringent predecessor Of Violence (2019), the trio embarks on a more open and playful approach, without losing the raw power and intensity they are known for. The album was created in collaboration with sound engineer Mark Roberts (Delta Sleep, Black Peaks, etc.) and shows Town Portal as a band that insists on the importance of creativity – even in a time marked by turmoil and crisis.

The release concert gives the audience a unique opportunity to experience the new material live for the first time. On stage, Town Portal combines virtuosity and energy in an uncompromising expression, where rhythmic complexity meets melodic clarity, and where surprises, heaviness and lightness exist side by side. The music is not only technically impressive, but also conveys the themes that run through the album: an insistence that it is still meaningful to create and find joy through art.

On Grindwork, the band has also opened the door to new collaborations. Two of the tracks have been expanded with string arrangements created by Nicole Hogstrand (Halvcirkel, CRUSH String Collective, Damkapellet) and Lisa Marie Vogel (Toechter), adding a new dimension to Town Portal's sound universe. At the concert, you can expect to hear these works unfold in an intense interplay between the raw and the vulnerable.

Town Portal consists of Christian Henrik Ankerstjerne (guitar), Malik Breuer Bistrup (drums) and Morten Ogstrup Nielsen (bass). Over the years, they have played at festivals such as ArcTanGent, A Colossal Weekend and Portals and shared the stage with bands such as Thrice and The Dillinger Escape Plan. With Grindwork and this release concert, they are writing a new chapter in their history – inviting the audience into a universe where music is both resistance, play and pure creative joy.

name: Tøjbyttemarked & Sysalon
description:
Mærk glæden ved genbrug! Kom forbi til tøjbyttemarked og sysalon, hvor du kan bytte dig til nyt eller upcycle dit tøj 〰️🧵

Måske er garderoben blevet for lille, for stor eller bare lidt kedelig? I sysalonen finder du alt fra stofrester og mønstre til symaskiner og broderimaterialer, som du frit kan bruge til at reparere eller redesigne dit tøj. Du behøver ikke at kunne sy på forhånd – vi hjælper dig i gang.  

Til tøjbyttemarkedet kan du aflevere tøj, du ikke længere går med, men som kan have brugsværdi for andre, og bytte med andres guld fra gemmerne. 

Det er gratis at være med, så kom forbi og mærk glæden ved genbrug!

name: AFLYST
description:
Musikkultur og fællesskab. Det er for dig, der elsker musik, der har lyst til at prøve nye ting af og vil jamme med andre. Det er et space, hvor du må udtrykke dig selv gennem musikken, også selvom du synes, du er lidt dårlig. Det er i variationen mellem genrer, niveauer og udtryksformer, at magien findes, og Jam 53 bliver til et rum, hvor musikken connecter os på tværs af forskelligheder. 

Aftenens husband starter aftenen ud, og derefter er der åben scene og åben jam, så kom forbi og giv et nummer. Følg med på uKirkes Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/uKirke/?locale=da_DK] og Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/ukirke/?hl=da] for offentliggørelse af aftenens husband. 

16+ i døren, 18+ i baren 

uKirke er et sted, der er åbent for alle. Kom som du er, uanset hvem du er, hvad du tror på, og hvem du elsker. Vi accepterer ikke diskrimination! Vi tolererer ikke medbragt alkohol.

Jam 53 er tilrettelagt af en gruppe unge frivillige. 
I efteråret kommer du også til at møde præst Benjamin Thomas König til alle vores events.

name: Fernisering: 'Vi spejler os i ord'
description:
'Vi spejler os i ord' er en samskabt udstilling, der dokumenterer Læseforeningens indsats i Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri og Socialpsykiatri gennem fotos, lyd og dokumentariske digte. 

Udstillingen er formet af antropolog og dokumentarisk kunstner Arendse Reeh (f. 1997) i samarbejde med deltagere fra læsefællesskaber ved Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup og Kompasset - et aktivitets- og samværstilbud i Sundby. Udstillingen ønsker at dokumentere, hvad skønlitterære læsefællesskaber kan for mennesker med psykiatrierfaring udtrykt med deres egne ord, blik og stemmer. 

Udstillingen består af tre dele; en videoinstallation, en fotoserie og dokumentariske langdigte. Alt sammen formet i en samskabende proces med deltagerne i læsefællesskaberne. Udstillingen bliver vist i LiteraturHaus og på Nørrebro Bibliotek i November og December 2025. 

Vi holder fernisering fra 16.30 - 19.00 med bobler og snacks. Hus at medbringe høretelefoner.

Støttet af Velux Fonden.

name: Few Tickets Left // Nancy Ajram - Headliner Show // KB.HALLEN
description:
KÆMPE NYHED - NANCY AJRAM KOMMER TIL DANMARK!

Dette bliver Nancy Ajrams eneste headliner-show i hele Skandinavien!

For allerførste gang i Danmark, kan vi præsentere den ikoniske arabiske superstjerne Nancy Ajram LIVE i KB Hallen, København den 15. november 2025!

Nancy Ajram er en af de mest ikoniske og indflydelsesrige stemmer i den arabiske musiks verden, og hendes sjældne optrædener gør denne koncert til en helt særlig begivenhed. Med millioner af fans verden over og et hav af hits i bagagen, kan du forvente en uforglemmelig aften fyldt god stemning og kulturrig musik.

Grib muligheden for eksklusivt at opleve en verdensstjerne helt tæt på - og det sker lige her i hjertet af København!

Billetsalget er LIVE!

-

MAJOR ANNOUNCEMENT - NANCY AJRAM IS COMING TO DENMARK!

This will be Nancy Ajram’s only headliner show in all of Scandinavia - and it’s happening right here in Copenhagen!

For the very first time in Denmark, we are proud to present the iconic Arabic superstar Nancy Ajram LIVE at KB Hallen, Copenhagen on November 15, 2025!

Nancy Ajram is one of the most iconic and influential voices in the world of Arabic music, and her rare performances make this concert a truly special event. With millions of fans across the globe and a long list of unforgettable hits, you can expect an extraordinary night filled with great energy and culturally rich music.

Don’t miss this exclusive chance to experience a global superstar up close - right in the heart of Copenhagen!

name: Mantra + kirtan i salen!
description: 'Mantra - Sounds into Silence' explores the new music and social phenomenon of chanting. The film shares the stories of people who are finding healing and a sense of inner peace by singing mantras together with others just like them. It's a film about spirituality not religion, it's about people reconnecting with their true selves and with others. As our characters' stories about their connection to the music unfold, we meet the musicians who have inspired them and brought them together. Through these encounters, we will discover how Deva Premal & Miten, Krishna Das, Snatam Kaur, Lama Gyurme, Jai Uttal, MC Yogi and others came to this music themselves and to the practice of 'Kirtan', and how, over the years, it transformed their lives. After the movie there will be a short Kirtan (mantrasinging) so those who wants can get a tastew of "the bliss of kirtan" . Kirtan by @GopiAnand kirtan and @Jacobweise

name: Testing Ground :  Sidsel Nelund : Fear in the Creative Process – Who is Afraid of Fear? (Part 2)
description:
Join us for a workshop with art researcher, non-fiction writer, and cyclical agent Sidsel Nelund, who will bring together art professionals to explore the subject of fear. This session is the second of three in the open research investigation 'Who’s Afraid of Fear?'

In a critical era of polycrisis, fear is both a physical and mental force that transforms the art profession. Throughout the fall, we will approach fear from different perspectives and in multiple ways.

This session will take the form of a one-day workshop for 8–12 artists and creative producers. Participants will be invited to dive into fear as part of the creative process. Guided by cyclical principles, Nelund will lead the group through five phases, exploring questions such as: Where does fear arise in the creative process? Who and what are we afraid of? What is ours to face—or not? Together, we will work to transform the isolating forces of unspoken fear to bring artistic and creative practice center stage.

Coffee, lunch, dinner, and beverages will be provided as part of the program.

OUTPUT
As part of the session, we have invited artist and clairvoyant Any Ramdas and artist and writer Sidsel Ana Gajardo to respond with visual and written notes, which serve as documentation of the open research and its findings. All statements are anonymized and documents are made available to be shared among participants.

WHO CAN JOIN?
Professional artists, curators, and educators at any career stage, working in all media: drawing, painting, sculpture, installation, fiber arts, photography, film, video, new media, fiction and non-fiction writing, poetry, playwriting, screenwriting, performance, dance, choreography, music, interdisciplinary social practice, arts administration, environmental art, tech art/gaming art, and architecture.

HOW TO JOIN?
Sidsel Nelund will curate a group of 8–12 artists to ensure complementary approaches to the subject matter. If you would like to join, please send an email to Tina Ryoon at AHC: tr@arthubcopenhagen.dk with the subject line: Who's Afraid of Fear Workshop. Include a short motivation (max. 400 characters) on why you would like to participate.

Deadline to apply: 29 October
Notification of participation: by 3 November

~

ABOUT WHO'S AFRAID OF FEAR?
Who's Afraid of Fear? growsfrom observing fear as a major obstacle in the artistic professions – and often in unspoken ways. This underlying fear drive hinders art production and Who's Afraid of Fear? sets outto find ways to localize and transform this fear and release what fear holds back. Taking inspiration from Black African American embodiment traditions and South American hospicing modernity practices, Sidsel Nelund will, over a series of sharing sessions, weave together a hybrid method that is at once theoretical, communal, and emotional. Rooted in the cyclical creativity approach she has developed over the past decade, these sessions will explore fear with curiosity and connection.

Nelund hopes to inspire a practice of courageous togetherness. Since fear both binds people and disperses them, what might happen if we gather to normalize fear and find ways to move beyond it?

The investigation is conducted as part of a book project that Sidsel Nelund explores through the Testing Ground residency, an AHC public programme aimed at providing artistic researchers with the opportunity to test ideas and methods in practice.
